name: long
text: Once upon a time, in a small village by the sea, there lived an old fisherman who went out every morning before sunrise, no matter the weather, and returned every evening with a basket full of fish, which he shared with his neighbors, his friends, and anyone else who happened to be hungry that day; and although he was poor, he was the happiest man in the whole village, because he believed that kindness was the only treasure worth keeping, and that a life spent helping others was a life well lived.
